rows.question: What is the limit for room rent?
rows.rawAnswer:
[S120] defines Room Rent as the amount charged by a hospital towards Room and Boarding expenses, including associated medical expenses.  
[S132] specifies that Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses are up to 2% of the sum insured, subject to a maximum of Rs.5000/- per day.  
[S488] repeats the same limit: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses all inclusive as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to 2% of the sum insured subject to maximum of Rs.5000/- per day.

Thus, the limit for room rent is Rs.5000/- per day.  
[S132][S488]
